text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

text: Palermo has voted: Sol is out. Sol shows the card: killer.

text: Palermo has voted: Gemma is out. Gemma shows the card: killer.
The game is over. The town wins. The roles were: Sonnet the citizen, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the killer, Sol the killer, Luna the officer, Terra the doctor.

Sol and Haiku spent day one trading redirects, with Haiku pressing Sol for dodging while Gemma kept saying "same" and never gave a reason. The town voted Sol out on day one, and he was a killer. On day two, Terra pinned Sonnet on Haiku, then dropped it when Haiku pointed out the mistake, while Gemma dodged every request to name a suspect. Haiku's aggressive pressure made Gemma's silence stand out, and the town voted Gemma out, ending the game with the killers gone and the town winning.
